notes: Sourced from Blackmagic Design's official Tech Specs page for the current-generation "Blackmagic Audio Monitor 12G G3" (the model the manufacturer currently sells under the "Audio Monitor 12G" name; earlier non-G3 revisions existed but this is the authoritative current spec sheet, fetched via https://www.blackmagicdesign.com/products/blackmagicaudiomonitor/techspecs). All video/audio/network grades (12G-SDI, HDMI 2.0, 10G Ethernet) are explicitly confirmed in the spec text. The AC power inlet connector style (IEC C13/C14 vs other) is not spelled out in the text spec sheet -- it is inferred as a standard IEC inlet based on Blackmagic's typical 1RU product design; treat that one port as medium confidence. The 2 analog XLR inputs and 2 RCA HiFi inputs are listed as counts without individual per-jack labels on the rear panel silkscreen, so port names here are inferred/generic rather than verbatim panel labels. Device also has a 2.2" built-in color LCD, front-panel LED meter bridge, and internal stereo speakers with dual subwoofers (not physical I/O ports, so omitted from the port list).
